title: Algolia Recommend pricing - Per-request add-on to search plans
clean_text: Algolia Recommend is priced at $0.60 per 1,000 recommendation requests per month, available only on Algolia's Premium and Elevate search plan tiers. The first 10,000 recommend requests per month are included free. AI recommendations as an add-on typically increase total Algolia contract value by 20 to 40 percent. Algolia's base search pricing starts with a free tier of 10,000 search requests per month, then $0.50 per 1,000 requests on the pay-as-you-go plan.
